about: Which release is offered and which of its files each system downloads (UpdateChoice).

cases.about: Pre-releases count: every release so far is one. The portable zips are not installers.
No downgrade, even when only older releases are listed.
A tag is `v` + MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional -prerelease: no leading zeros, build metadata or spaces.
CFBundleShortVersionString / the Windows version: no `v`, three numbers.
The version is still offered, with its release page only.
300 MiB = 314572800 bytes is the largest accepted.
A .sha256 over 1024 bytes makes its system uninstallable; SHA256SUMS.sig may have 1024, SHA256SUMS 65536.
sha256:<hex> in any case gives lowercase hex; another algorithm or null gives null; a malformed sha256 refuses the file.
Debug builds with LUMERIST_UPDATE_FEED_URL: file: URLs without a host are accepted too.
